target.statement: RMSE of the observation error variances [σ²_v,1, σ²_v,2] for ROAMS relative to the oracle benchmark in the 'Cluster' outlier configuration at sample size n=1000, reported as 1.02 in Table 1.
target.table_ref: Table 1, row '[σ²_v,1, σ²_v,2]', column 'ROAMS', configuration 'Cluster', n=1000
target.dataset: Simulated data from the paper's Study 1 (Cluster configuration, n=1000, 10% outliers, 200 simulation runs)

compute.basis: The target requires running 200 simulation replicates of a small linear Gaussian SSM (n=1000, p=2, q=4) with iterative L-BFGS-B optimization and BIC tuning over 20 lambda values; each replicate is fast on CPU, but 200 replicates plus code adaptation from the R package (no explicit simulation scripts linked) may take about 2 hours.

blockers: No direct link to simulation code or data; only a package website is provided, so simulation scripts must be written from scratch.
The R package roams is available but the exact simulation setup (random seeds, outlier generation) is not provided, requiring reimplementation.
title: Outlier detection in state-space models using mean-shift penalisation
